title: Lightly Crisp French Peas Pilaf
description: A nutty and energizing French dish featuring frozen peas, this pilaf is a diabetic-friendly option for a quick and easy meal. It is made with a variety of ingredients to create a delicious and healthy dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the thawed peas and cook until they are tender.
Add the brown rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the peas and onion mixture.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and season with salt and black pepper.
If using grated cheese, sprinkle it on top of the pilaf and serve.
Serve the pilaf hot and enjoy.
